keyEvents.text: Adam Gnezda Cerin (Slovenia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! North Macedonia 0, Slovenia 1. Danijel Sturm (Slovenia) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Zan Vipotnik with a through ball following a fast break.
First Half ends, North Macedonia 0, Slovenia 1.
Substitution, North Macedonia. Azer Omeragikj replaces Agon Elezi.
Substitution, North Macedonia. Ljupcho Doriev replaces Bojan Ilievski.
Substitution, North Macedonia. Hristijan Maleski replaces Darko Churlinov.
Substitution, Slovenia. Srdjan Kuzmic replaces Erik Janza.
Second Half begins North Macedonia 0, Slovenia 1.
Zan Karnicnik (Slovenia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ezgjan Alioski (North Macedonia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Slovenia. Mark Zabukovnik replaces Sandi Lovric.
Goal! North Macedonia 0, Slovenia 2. David Zec (Slovenia) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Zan Vipotnik with a headed pass following a corner.
Substitution, North Macedonia. Marko Gjorgjievski replaces Elmin Rastoder.
Substitution, Slovenia. Benjamin Verbic replaces Aljosa Matko.
Substitution, Slovenia. Andraz Sporar replaces Zan Vipotnik.
Benjamin Verbic (Slovenia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
